question: Oda-sensei, nice to meet you! About Katakuri, we know that he likes to eat sweets, but in matter of disliking, what is his least favorite food, is it spicy food? -
answer: His least favorite food is hot ramen. When dining with others, being seen while eating is his mortal weakness, which is why he hates ramen. Spicy food is fine though.
name: Yukito
